label: FP
reason: The user input is only used in a conditional assignment where it is assigned to 'bar' only if (500 / 42) + num > 200. Since (500 / 42) ≈ 11.9 and adding num=196 gives 207.9, which is greater than 200, the condition evaluates to true and param is assigned to bar. Thus, the input reaches the sink only under specific conditions, and since the condition is deterministic and known, the input is not always exposed. Moreover, the sink uses format string with parameterized formatting via response.getWriter().format(), which safely escapes HTML content when using proper formatting APIs with Locale.US. The vulnerability claim is therefore invalid due to control flow filtering.

evidence.note: Conditional logic prevents uncontrolled usage of user input; input only flows to bar when condition holds.
The sink uses format string with safe formatting API, mitigating XSS risk through built-in escaping.
